Lane changes made to pass the gates: dropped a test that include_str!'d codex memory (zkfmi-crypto), removed unused [patch] overlays whose lock ordering was non-deterministic (qomm, aethel), regenerated the qomm/defmi/aethel lock files in the container, filled the NoteClaim authorization field in the aethel host tests.

supporting_gates.scope: cargo metadata --locked and cargo check --locked --all-targets --all-features across all nine workspaces (pqc-workspace-check.sh)

evidence_limits.corporate_api_restart_exact_wire_claim: deterministic journal gate plus native API/custody execution; the native scenario did not separately repeat the exact corporate API crash window

release_pinning.blocker: Cross-repository dependency cycle on the lane: defmi/rust consumes qomm-transport, qomm-mpc, qomm-dsl, qomm-sim, qomm-audit and qomm-measure from qomm, while qomm/rust consumes qomm-defmi, zkpi-defmi-sdk and qomm-avalanche-vm from defmi. Immutable git pins cannot express that cycle (one side is always stale and cargo would resolve two revisions of the same crate); the lane builds only through the sibling [patch] overlays. Breaking the cycle is the crate consolidation in CRATE_LAYOUT.md (move the committee half of qomm-transport under zkpi so that defmi depends on zkpi only).
release_pinning.lane_branches_remain: codex/pqc-astra-high on defmi, qomm, oclob, aethel carry the accepted state; build them as sibling checkouts under one root as scripts/pqc-remote.sh does.

second_run.reason: Rerun after moving qomm-transport, qomm-mpc, qomm-audit, qomm-dsl, qomm-sim and qomm-measure from qomm/rust to zkpi/rust to break the defmi <-> qomm dependency cycle (see CRATE_LAYOUT.md); manifests of qomm, defmi, oclob and aethel re-sourced to zkpi, locks regenerated in the container, unused patch entries removed (aethel).
